Condition : 1 - 1.0	GRANT permission to vary Condition No.10

Reasons

The proposed variation of condition No.10 to include reference to a drawing indicating a revised parking layout with six less car parking spaces and a minibus drop off point, together with improved disabled parking facilities (4 extra width spaces) is considered to be acceptable in respect of highway safety and free flow, and satisfactory and appropriate parking provision, including parking for disabled users, and in compliance with policies B.1.1 (New Development), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments), T.4.3 (Traffic Implications of New Development), and T.4.4 (Road Safety) of the London Borough of Hounslow's adopted Unitary Development Plan 2003.

Condition:
1			Condition No.10 as variedBefore first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No.1012010 Revision H and such spaces shall be permanently  available and not be used for any other purpose.REASON:- (No change)
description: Variation of Condition 10 (Parking Scheme) of planning permission ref. 1660/B/P1 dated 19/3/04 to allow for a mini bus drop off point
